# Save the fleet either way

Asking risks hearing an unwelcome answer but allows Ivo to take responsibility and help ring the bell. Leaving refuses further dependence on him; Mara warns the fleet with a horn while he remains alone. The decision affects player information, Character knowledge, their Relationship and the ending, not whether the player arbitrarily loses the game.
